body.name: absolutely continuous conditional-support-hole witness
body.construction: Fix \(p_{\circ}\in(0,1)\), let \(I=[-2,2]\), and set \(K=L=M=1\). Under \(P^{\circ}\), \(Y_1=Y_2=0\), \(D_1=X\), \(D_2=X+Z\), and \((X,Z)\) has Lebesgue density \(2p_{\circ}\) on \([-1,0]\times[1/2,1]\), density \(2(1-p_{\circ})\) on \([0,1]\times[-1/4,1/4]\), and zero elsewhere. Define \(u_+^{\circ}(x)=\min\{-x,1/2\}\) for \(x\in[-1,0]\) and \(u_+^{\circ}(x)=0\) for \(x\in[0,1]\), and set \(u_-^{\circ}=-u_+^{\circ}\). For \(s\in\{+,-\}\), retain the observed variables under \(P^{\circ}\) and define \(Y_1^{Q_s^{\circ}}(d)=-u_s^{\circ}(X)(d-X)/Z\) and \(Y_2^{Q_s^{\circ}}(d)=-u_s^{\circ}(X)(d-D_2)/Z\) for \(d\in[-2,2]\), with both quotients set to zero on the \(P^{\circ}\)-null event \(Z=0\).
